# DSH Session Metrics
English | 中文
`dsh-session-metrics` is a community desktop plugin (not an official DeepSeek product) for DSH 0.2.0
-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2. It replaces DSH's shipped statistics band below the composer with one row show
ing billed tokens, context usage, cache hit, model time, the running turn's model time, tool time, t
urns and steps; everything else lives in a hover panel. It modifies no core code, writes no files, a
nd starts no separate service.
## Behavior
- The Host subscribes to `session/event` and folds the durable log into per-Session counters: `turn/
start` and `step/start` drive the turn and step counts, `step/start` to `assistant/message` is the m
odel wall time for one step, and `tool/call`/`tool/result` pairs give per-tool call counts and durat

ions.
- Every figure is a delta between log commit timestamps, not an observer's wall clock. A Sessi
on that already existed when the plugin loaded is backfilled from `session.snapshotEvents()`, and ea
ch later append is folded exactly once by `seq`; a Session disposed in the Host is dropped from memo

ry.
- The row reads the shipped `contextPressure`, `sessionStats` and `tokenUsage` projections, so i
ts figures match DSH's own and update live. `本轮模型` is the turn-scoped model time: the running turn's
charged and in-flight model time, or the most recently closed turn's while idle. Hovering (or focus
ing/clicking) the row opens a panel styled like the shipped stat dialog: tool-call count and failure
s, the turn's model time, Session span, context use and its breakdown, the token split, and the top
tools by accumulated time. Token and context figures use k/M units with each part shown as a share.

It closes on Escape, an outside press, or when the pointer leaves.
- The Host route supplies only wh
at the projections lack (tool-call count, per-tool times, failures, Session span, the turn-scoped mo
del time). It is polled every 2.5 seconds while the page is visible, because the row itself carries

the turn figure; polling pauses while the page is hidden.
- If neither the projections nor the Host

have data, the row stays hidden.
- The local `/myspace-session-metrics/api` route accepts only loopb
ack, a valid Host, same-origin Origin/Fetch Metadata, and the `X-DSH-Session-Metrics: 1` header, and
only `GET` with a validated `sessionId`. Counters live in memory and are lost when the plugin unloa

ds or DSH restarts; nothing is written to disk.
- The row registers as `id: stats` at `priority: -1`
in `conversation.composer.dock`, shadowing the legacy shipped stats cell. On newer DSH, empty overr
ides at the same priority also shadow the split `activity` and `usage` cells, preventing duplicate s
tatistics without hiding other plugins' dock entries. The legacy context meter beside the slot is hi
dden because its figure is in the row. The root keeps the shipped `data-composer-stats` hook so them
es style one band with one top rule. Disabling the plugin releases all overrides and restores the sh
ipped statistics and meter.
## Development and installation
Install the npm package `dsh-session-metrics` through the DSH plugin manager. Only the desktop profi
le is supported; do not install it in the Web profile.
No build is required; the native ModuleLoader Client ships in the package. For development, install
`link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-metrics` and restart DSH after Host changes, because the Host mo
dule cache is not reloaded by a page refresh.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Tests cover the log fold (turn/step/model/tool accounting, turn-scoped model time, unterminated tool
calls, replay idempotence, formatting), the Host route boundary (Session-id validation, loopback/sa
me-origin/header gate, tracker backfill, disposal), and the Client half (the bundle loads through th
e ModuleLoader seam, shadows the shipped stats cell, renders the row from the shipped projections pl
us the Host's turn figure, falls back to the Host reading, stays empty for an empty Session or an un
reachable Host, and skips polling while the page is hidden). Runtime acceptance on a live DSH deskto
p session — the row and the hover panel — must be verified separately; passing unit tests is not run
row and the hover panel — must be verified separately; passing unit tests is not runtime acceptance.
## Limitations
- Token counts are reported by the provider; a step without a `usage` record contributes duration bu

t no tokens, and the cache-hit share stays `—` instead of showing a made-up percentage.
- Tool durat
ions cover only calls that both started and ended inside the observed log; a call still open when it

s turn closes is counted as one failed call.
- `本轮模型` follows the whole-log model figure: a turn who
se steps assemble no assistant message (cancelled mid-stream, for example) charges no model time, so

between turns the item keeps the last closed turn's value.
- Counters start from the Session log th
e Host can see. A Session restored from storage without its events replayed contributes only its new

appends.
- The Host reading is a polled read of local counters; it is not a tracing or billing sour
ce, and it does not upload anything.
## Trusted publishing
The publishing workflow uses GitHub Actions OIDC without storing an npm token. Run it manually on `m
ain` with the reviewed full commit SHA in `expected_sha`. `dry_run` defaults to true; set it to fals
e only for an approved new-version publication. The workflow rejects a mismatched SHA before publish
ing. Committing the workflow does not configure the npm Trusted Publisher; do that in the package se
ttings on npmjs.com.
